## mossyforest

*Network Aware Stability Selection with Random Forests*

An R package (submitted to CRAN) for interpretable, network-aware, tree-based feature selection on highly correlated, high-dimensional data, using SHAP values and Recursive Feature Elimination. 

- Timothy Shen and Christina Ramirez. R package version 0.1.0 (2026).
- [GitHub](https://github.com/timothyzshen/mossyforest)

```r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("timothyzshen/mossyforest")
```

- [Documentation](https://timothyzshen.github.io/mossyforest/)

## mossyforest-py
